items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had Albert Jive on drums, D on trumpet, I'm on piano, just three pieces.

ctx.x: Who was with you at this place at St. Bernard and St. Claude?
Let me see. Who had one drum? Was it Albert Jive? Albert. Right. I had Albert Jive on drums, D on trumpet, I'm on piano, just three pieces.
And from there you went to Bunky?

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: We went upstairs somewhere, old band, old band, old band, I'm trying to think, me, old band, Albert Glennon, George Henderson.

ctx.x: I'm making a thing, we started playing some mocha, we went upstairs, if I'm not mistaken.
We went upstairs somewhere, old band, old band, old band, I'm trying to think, me, old band, Albert Glennon, George Henderson.
